entities.name: answers
entities.label: Answers
entities.description: Each AI engine answer to a tracked prompt, with whether it named or cited you.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.answerCount
metrics.label: Answer count
metrics.description: Number of AI engine answers for the selected filters.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.mentionedCount
metrics.label: Mentioned answers
metrics.description: Answers that mention the brand (numerator for namedRate rollups).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.citedCount
metrics.label: Cited answers
metrics.description: Answers citing owned domains (numerator for citedRate rollups).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.namedRate
metrics.label: Named rate
metrics.description: Share of answers mentioning the brand (0–100). Weighted ratio: sum(mentionedCount)/sum(answerCount).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.citedRate
metrics.label: Cited rate
metrics.description: Share of answers citing owned domains (0–100). Weighted ratio: sum(citedCount)/sum(answerCount).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.avgCitedPosition
metrics.label: Avg cited position
metrics.description: Average citation position when the brand is cited (lower is better).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.distinctSources
metrics.label: Distinct sources
metrics.description: Distinct citation domains across answers for the prompt.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.answers.promptCount
metrics.label: Prompt count
metrics.description: Distinct tracked prompts in the filtered answers.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Run date (warehouse partition key).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.id
dimensions.label: Answer ID
dimensions.description: Stable 16-character hex id derived from the run key (promptId#platform#date). Join claims via claim.answerId = answers.id.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.promptId
dimensions.label: Prompt ID
dimensions.description: Tracked prompt that produced this answer.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.platform
dimensions.label: Platform
dimensions.description: AI engine that generated the answer (for example ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.ranAt
dimensions.label: Ran at
dimensions.description: Timestamp when the answer was fetched.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.country
dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country context used when the prompt was run.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.excerpt
dimensions.label: Excerpt
dimensions.description: Short preview of the answer text shown in list views.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.answerMarkdown
dimensions.label: Answer markdown
dimensions.description: Full answer content in markdown format.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.mentioned
dimensions.label: Mentioned
dimensions.description: Whether the brand was mentioned in the answer.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.cited
dimensions.label: Cited
dimensions.description: Whether owned brand domains were cited as sources in the answer.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.citedPosition
dimensions.label: Cited position
dimensions.description: Position of the brand citation in the answer source list (1-based; 0 when not cited).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.sourceDomains
dimensions.label: Source domains
dimensions.description: Domains cited as sources in the answer.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.competitorsNamed
dimensions.label: Competitors named
dimensions.description: Competitor brands named in the answer.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.sources
dimensions.label: Sources JSON
dimensions.description: JSON array of citations in display order: position, label, url (Answers tab Sources accordion).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.entities
dimensions.label: Entities JSON
dimensions.description: JSON array of brand/entity names also named in the answer (Also Named accordion).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.map
dimensions.label: Map JSON
dimensions.description: JSON array of local/map listings: name, lat, lng, rating, reviews, category, open, address, image, url.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.relatedQueries
dimensions.label: Related queries JSON
dimensions.description: JSON array of related follow-up query strings (e.g. Perplexity).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.citationPills
dimensions.label: Citation pills JSON
dimensions.description: JSON array of ChatGPT citation pill metadata when present.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.answers.clientName
dimensions.label: Client name
dimensions.description: Client display name (account-level queries only).

entities.name: sources
entities.label: Sources
entities.description: The domains and pages AI engines cite, and how often.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.citations
metrics.label: Citations
metrics.description: Total citation count for the domain in the period.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.citationShare
metrics.label: Citation share
metrics.description: Share of all citations attributed to this domain (0–100).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.citationChange
metrics.label: Citation change
metrics.description: Period-over-period change in citation share.

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.promptsInfluenced
metrics.label: Prompts influenced
metrics.description: Distinct tracked prompts where this domain was cited (per domain snapshot).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.lastSeenMax
metrics.label: Last seen
metrics.description: Most recent citation time for the domain (use instead of grouping by lastSeen).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.avgPosition
metrics.label: Avg position
metrics.description: Average citation position for this domain in AI answers (lower is better).

metrics.name: aiVisibility.sources.pageCount
metrics.label: Pages cited
metrics.description: Distinct canonical cited page URLs for this domain (pages JSON length after merge; UTM and text fragments deduped).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Run date for citation aggregates.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.id
dimensions.label: Source ID
dimensions.description: Stable 16-character hex id derived from the canonical citation domain. Use domain for display.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.domain
dimensions.label: Domain
dimensions.description: Citation domain influencing AI answers.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.ownership
dimensions.label: Ownership
dimensions.description: Whether the domain is owned by the brand or an earned third-party source.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.category
dimensions.label: Category
dimensions.description: Domain category (for example news, review, or social).

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.platforms
dimensions.label: Platforms
dimensions.description: AI engines where this domain was cited.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.pages
dimensions.label: Pages JSON
dimensions.description: JSON list of cited pages with URL, title, and position details.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.claimIds
dimensions.label: Claim IDs
dimensions.description: Claim IDs linked to this citation source.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.recommendedAction
dimensions.label: Recommended action
dimensions.description: Suggested action to improve visibility for this source.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.lastSeen
dimensions.label: Last seen
dimensions.description: Most recent time this domain was cited.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.sources.clientName
dimensions.label: Client name
dimensions.description: Client display name (account-level queries only).

entities.name: retrieval

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.id

dimensions.description: Stable 16-character hex id derived from the canonical (lowercase) retrieval query text. Use query for display.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.query
dimensions.label: Query

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.promptIds
dimensions.label: Prompt IDs
dimensions.description: Tracked prompts that triggered this retrieval query.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.platforms
dimensions.label: Platforms
dimensions.description: AI engines that issued this retrieval query.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.ownedPageRetrieved
dimensions.label: Owned page retrieved
dimensions.description: Whether an owned brand page appeared in retrieval results.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.retrieval.clientName
dimensions.label: Client name
dimensions.description: Client display name (account-level queries only).

entities.name: claim

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.promptCount

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.claimsConflict

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.accuracyRate

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.coveragePrompts

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.coverageUnsolicited

metrics.name: aiVisibility.claim.coveragePromptDriven

metrics.description: Distinct prompts where the claim appeared because the prompt asked about the claim group.

dimensions.name: aiVisibility.claim.claimId
